data.narrative:
Vantage Robotics is a Series C-stage defense and security robotics company founded by Tobin Fisher and Joe van Niekerk. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 13 same-sector companies at comparable or adjacent stages, including eight private firms (Quantum-Systems, Helsing, Saronic, Anduril Industries, Shield AI, Neros, and others) and two public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). The peer universe spans valuations from $300M to $18.0B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the company's $45.6M total raised as a proxy base value, applying a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C-to-subsequent-stage advancement, yielding $78M. Peer-median analysis across the 13-company Defense & Security cohort produced a median valuation of $2.1B, with notable comparables including Quantum-Systems at $8.0B (Series C), Helsing at $18.0B (Series D), and Saronic at $9.2B (Series D).

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $66M to $2.5B, with a median of $1.1B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Vantage Robotics will track toward the lower end (stage-progression, near-term funding rounds) or compress toward upper-quartile defense-tech valuations evident in the peer set. Capital efficiency, addressable market penetration in defense procurement, and competitive positioning relative to Quantum-Systems and Anduril remain key value drivers not fully quantified in available data.
